name: Cannon AFB
description: Home of the 27th Special Operations Wing, Cannon AFB projects Air Force special operations forces worldwide from the high plains of eastern New Mexico.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Sextant Ave)
gates.notes: Primary installation access. After-hours unofficial visitor passes processed here 2200-0600 with sponsor present.
gates.address: E Sextant Ave, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

gates.name: West Gate
gates.address: West Gate Rd, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor vetting. REAL ID required. After 2200 use Main Gate with sponsor.

resources.name: Pecos Trail Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC with N'Rich Grill, SubConnection deli, Slice Of Life pizza, salad bar, and Simply To Go coolers.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0800, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1930; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0730-0900, Lunch 1030-1300, Dinner 1630-1800
resources.address: 203 Air Commando Way, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: High Plains Dining Facility
resources.description: Secondary DFAC serving the south side of the installation.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0530-0900, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner Mon-Thu 1700-1900, Fri 1700-1800
resources.address: 100 S Dagger Rd, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Cannon Landing Zone (Air Force Club)
resources.description: Air Force Club with lunch specials, catering, and event hosting.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri lunch 1100-1300; evening events on FSS event calendar

resources.name: Cannon AFB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service BX with retail, food court, barber, beauty shop, and services.
resources.address: 102 Levitow Ave, Bldg 77B, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Cannon AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery with bakery, deli, and butcher services.
resources.address: 102 Levitow Ave, Bldg 77-A, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Cannon Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union with deposit accounts, loans, and ATM.
resources.address: 102 Air Commando Way, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: 27th Special Operations Medical Group Clinic
resources.description: Ambulatory clinic for primary care and TRICARE services. No emergency department on base — call 911 or use Plains Regional Medical Center.
resources.address: 208 D.L. Ingram Ave, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Cannon Fitness & Sport Center
resources.description: Main fitness center with cardio, weights, racquetball, basketball, group fitness, and saunas. Register CAC at front desk for 24/7 access.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0500-2200, Sat-Sun 0900-1800; 24/7 CAC access after registration
resources.address: 400 Air Commando Way, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Commando Fitness & Aquatic Center (DZ Aquatic)
resources.description: Aquatic center with lap pool and family swim programs. CAC registration required for after-hours access.
resources.hours: Manned Mon/Wed/Fri 0500-1800; preregister CAC at fitness desk

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Use RAPIDS for appointments.

resources.name: 27th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, lodging, and community events.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial management, career focus, transition assistance, and family readiness. Mandatory Commando Newcomers Orientation for permanent party.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1130 & 1230-1630; closed Wed, holidays, safety days, and training days
resources.address: 331 D.L. Ingram Ave, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Housing Office
resources.description: On-base privatized housing and off-base housing referrals.

resources.name: Caprock Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: 88 one- or two-bedroom VQ and TLF units. 24-hour arrival point for after-hours PCS arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100
resources.address: 311 S Eagle Claw Blvd, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Whispering Winds Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole par 70 course with pro shop, driving range, and Chip Shot Diner.

resources.name: Cannon Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: 16-lane USBC-sanctioned bowling center with pro shop, leagues, and snack bar.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Camping gear, boats, campers, ski equipment, BBQ rentals, and organized outdoor trips.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0900-1700; closed Wed, holidays, safety days, and training days
resources.address: 110 W St, Bldg 215, Cannon AFB, NM 88103

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes, DBIDS vetting, and base access. REAL ID required.

events.title: Red Pin Wednesday
events.description: Every Wednesday, 3 PM – 9 PM Keep an eye on the pins—two red pins will be randomly placed on each lane. If a red pin shows up as the headpin and you roll a strike, let the front desk know and you will score a free game. Shoe rental is not included and remains $2. You do not have to use your free game the same day you earn it. It can be redeemed any time we are open, as long as it is used within that same month. Everyone is welcome to participate, so come bowl, get lucky, and enjoy the fun.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. After-hours arrivals check in at Caprock Inn (575-784-2918).

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival. Caprock Inn provides temporary lodging. On-base family housing managed by Cannon Housing.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 575-784-4228 if no sponsor is assigned 45 days before arrival.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and Military.com for relocation support.
